Where you have a Skywalker, you initiate battles for free. Once per turn, may deploy Anakin's Lightsaber or a [Cloud City] corridor from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per battle involving a Jedi Skywalker, may activate 1 Force. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[A Cunning Warrior]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[A Cunning Warrior]] (repository revision 30 December 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•A Cunning Warrior”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[A Jedi's Concentration]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
